action_dispatch.verdict: KEEP PYAUTOGUI: Win32 SendInput gain is sub-millisecond (within benchmark noise), PyAutoGUI with PAUSE=0 is already under 0.05 ms.

startup_architecture.perceived_startup_analysis: Because camera hardware takes ~7.4s while model init takes only ~24ms, parallelizing model init with camera open saves at most ~24ms (0.3% of startup). However, Perceived Startup can be reduced to <100ms by displaying the application window immediately with a status overlay ('Connecting to Camera...') while hardware initializes asynchronously.
